heading: Today
text: Periods of sun in southern valleys.  Morning clouds from the Green Mountains east, and Rt. 4 and the White Mountains north, with scattered showers, a stray afternoon thunderstorm, and some breaks of sun.  Cool.  Highs in the 60s to near 70 north, low to mid 70s in the Champlain Valley and south.  Light south winds becoming west less than 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Localized evening showers west and north tapering off.  Partly cloudy in southern valleys, and some partial clearing north.  Some patchy fog. Lows in the 50s, some upper 40s north.  Winds northwest up to 10 mph, becoming light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Some patchy valley fog, then partly to mostly sunny.  Highs in the 70s to around 80.  Winds light and variable.
